items.title: 17.2 AC ke liye mean taqat aur zyada se zyada taqat ka talluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of mean and maximum power in AC (PDF 89-90).

blocks.text: Alternating current dauri taur par simt badalta hai, is liye voltage aur current sine ki shakal mein badalte hain. Resistive load woh hai jo tawanai jama nahi karta (jaise capacitor ya inductor karte hain) balke seedhi hararat mein zaya karta hai. Circuit mein lamhati taqat kisi lamhe ki taqat hai: P = VI (17.5). Zyada se zyada (peak) taqat tab hoti hai jab current aur voltage apni peak qeematon Io aur Vo par hon; mean taqat aik mukammal chakkar ka aust hai (Fig 17.4).

Resistor R mein sine ki shakal ke AC ke liye zyada se zyada taqat Pmax = Io^2 R (17.6) aur mean taqat Pmean = Irms^2 R (17.7) hai. Kyunke Io = 2 ka square root x Irms, Pmax = 2 Irms^2 R = 2 Pmean, is liye Pmean = Pmax / 2 (17.8). Resistive load mein mean taqat zyada se zyada taqat ki aadhi hai: lamhati taqat chakkar ke kuch nuqton par inteha tak pohanchti lekin kafi waqt kam qeematon par, sifar tak, guzarti hai.

blocks.alt: Waqt ke muqable taqat ka graph: surkh curve sifar se zyada se zyada lakeer tak uth kar wapas sifar tak girta aur dohrata, sifar se oopar rehta; hawale ke liye dikhaye dashed neele current ke har chakkar mein do dafa chotti. Dashed lakeerein zyada se zyada taqat Pmax = VoIo = Io^2 R aur aadhi oonchai par mean taqat Pmean = (1/2)Pmax = Irms^2 R dikhati.
blocks.caption: AC wale resistor mein taqat (Fig 17.4 ke mutabiq asal graph).
blocks.long_description: Kyunke taqat current ke square par munhasir hai, yeh dono aadhe chakkaron mein musbat hai. Is ka aust bilkul peak ka aadha hai, isi liye rms qeematein peak ko 2 ke square root se taqseem karne se milti hain.

blocks.text: 50 ohm resistor par 220 V ka alternating voltage lagaya jata hai. Kitab ki tarah 220 V ko peak qeemat maan kar mean taqat kilowatt mein maloom karein. Hal: Pmax = V^2 / R = (220 V)^2 / 50 ohm = 968 W. Mean taqat aadhi hai: Pmean = 968 W / 2 = 484 W = 0.484 kW.

blocks.title: Peak ya rms?
blocks.text: Mains voltages aam taur par rms qeematon mein batayi jati hain. Agar Misal 17.2 ka 220 V rms qeemat ho to mean taqat Vrms^2 / R = (220 V)^2 / 50 ohm = 968 W, aur peak taqat 1936 W hogi.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Digital clamp meter circuit tore baghair AC aur DC current napta hai: is ke jabre aik taar ke gird band ho kar current ka magnetic field mehsoos karte hain. (Kitab aik tasveer bhi dikhati hai jis par likha hai 'scientists ne insani khoon ki shakkar ko bijli mein badla'.)

blocks.prompt: AC circuit mein aik resistor 200 W peak taqat zaya karta hai. Is ki mean taqat kya hai?

items: Har lamhe P = VI; Pmax = Io^2 R; Pmean = Irms^2 R.
